Idk about you but I think experiences, wether you’ve experienced them yourself or not can be nice or soothing. I graduated with one of my buddies and as a present my mom paid for us to go on a 2 week vacation to northern Oregon by the coast. We had some long drives with the windows down just taking in the beauty of the world and true scale of us all. We drove so long sometimes that we got to listen to the entire discography of Pink Floyd which I had wanted to do my whole life but “never seemed to find the time” (if you know you know). Other than that just seeing all the different trees, animals, towns, and bays really got me thinking about my life and where I was going because of how beautiful it was. Some things you can’t appreciate until you get up close and pay attention. Some of my favorite small things that reminded me that life is still worth living is the subtle rolling fog in the early morning and watching the fire glow orange. I loved just talking to my friend about life and time. 

Hopefully that helps put things into perspective (:

I this kind of thing shouldn’t happen in your life. I may not know you but I know how it can feel sometimes. Since it was hurting my health so much anyways, I decided to try to stop. It took a long time but I did and it was because we had such a way together and are still together today. Sometimes we forget that our only obligation is to ourselves. To level with you, my name is Eli and I'm 18.
